A bug-fix release.

## Fixes

- **Saving your Battle.net login no longer crashes the app** on Android 15 devices without a screen lock, which includes many handhelds. If saving is ever refused by the device, the app now shows a message instead.
- Removed an unused system permission (`READ_LOGS`), from the original wow-forever-android project.

## Install

Download **WoW-Foreverywhere.apk** below. If you have v0.2.0, it installs as an update. If you saved a login with v0.2.0, enter it once more under **Account**.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/YoruDev-Ryland/WoWForeverywhere#getting-started) for setup.
